name: Sakagaki Tsukasa
source:
A cheerful part-time worker.
She doesn't like thinking about difficult things.
She lives with her parents and leads a self-destructive lifestyle.
She likes branded products and has a strong interest in fashion.
Her favorite TV program is a comedy show.
She seems to be very interested in naughty things. 

[From Erogamescape]
